storyCards.headline: All She Wants To Do Is Dance: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Don Henley's "All She Wants To Do Is Dance" reached #9 on the Billboard Hot 100. "All She Wants to Do Is Dance" is a song written by Danny Kortchmar and performed by Don Henley, co-lead vocalist and drummer for Eagles.

It was released as the second single from Henley's second studio solo album, Building the Perfect Beast (1984), and was Henley's sixth solo single overall.

It was one of Henley's most commercially successful singles, peaking at No.

The song peaked at #9 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 19 weeks on the chart.

Chart story — peaked at #9 on the Hot 100.
